# Portrait picker triggers (see common/scripted_effects/rn_portrait_picker.txt).

# ROOT (player) scope: a portrait picker is open and nothing else blocks it.
rn_pp_is_open = {
	is_ai = no
	NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_open }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_input }
	OR = { has_country_flag = rn_pp_open_own has_country_flag = rn_pp_open_sub }
}

# Scope: the country whose leader's portrait changes. Its portrait cooldown is still running.
rn_pp_cooldown_active = {
	set_temp_variable = { rn_ip_cd_left = rn_ip_cd_portrait_until }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { rn_ip_cd_left = global.num_days }
	check_variable = { rn_ip_cd_left > 0 }
}

# Any scope: the rule offers other countries' portraits ("This country | All").
rn_pp_rule_all = {
	OR = {
		has_game_rule = { rule = rn_portrait_pool option = RN_PORTRAIT_POOL_ANY_LEADER }
		has_game_rule = { rule = rn_portrait_pool option = RN_PORTRAIT_POOL_ALL }
	}
}

# Any scope: the rule offers generals' and admirals' portraits ("Leaders | Generals").
rn_pp_rule_generals = {
	OR = {
		has_game_rule = { rule = rn_portrait_pool option = RN_PORTRAIT_POOL_OWN_GENERALS }
		has_game_rule = { rule = rn_portrait_pool option = RN_PORTRAIT_POOL_ALL }
	}
}

# ROOT (player) scope: the own leader's portrait. The rule rn_portrait_subjects can leave it to the
# overlord (a subject's player then cannot change it).
rn_pp_own_allowed = {
	NOT = { rn_feature_portrait_off = yes }
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_game_rule = { rule = rn_portrait_subjects option = RN_PORTRAIT_SUBJECTS_OVERLORD_ONLY } }
		is_subject = no
	}
}

# Scope: another country, ROOT the player (rights already checked by rn_sub_may_edit). The rule
# rn_portrait_subjects can keep an overlord from changing its subject's leader portrait.
rn_pp_sub_allowed = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_game_rule = { rule = rn_portrait_subjects option = RN_PORTRAIT_SUBJECTS_NO_OVERLORD } }
		NOT = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
	}
}
